# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and social media platform for finding and saving creative ideas across categories like fashion, home decor, recipes, and lifestyle inspiration.

Pinterest enables users to discover, collect, and organize visual content through boards and pins. The platform curates trending topics, seasonal content, and personalized recommendations across diverse categories from fashion trends like Adidas Sambas to home ideas and recipes.

## Key Topics

- Visual discovery platform
- Content boards and pins
- Trending ideas and seasonal trends
- Fashion inspiration (Adidas Sambas, Adidas Campus)
- Home decor and DIY projects
- Recipe discovery
- Aesthetic curation
- Personalized recommendations
- Category browsing
- Social media sharing
- Creative inspiration collections
- Lifestyle content
- Visual search

## Content Discovery

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://za.pinterest.com/ideas/): Content discovery hub featuring recipes, home ideas, style & trending topics
- [Explore the best of Pinterest (AU)](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Browse curated categories with visual inspiration and seasonal trends

## Official Profile

- [Pinterest Official Profile](https://www.pinterest.com/pinterest/): Official Pinterest profile showcasing curated content boards and collections
